data.title: Prosperous Future Proposes Auditor Change to Grant Thornton
data.description:
The latest update is out from Prosperous Future Holdings ( (HK:1259) ).

Prosperous Future Holdings has proposed changing its external auditor from BDO Limited to Grant Thornton Hong Kong Limited after the company and BDO failed to reach agreement on the proposed audit fee for the year ending 31 December 2026. BDO has resigned, while the board and audit committee said there is no disagreement beyond the fee issue and no other matters requiring shareholder attention.

The audit committee assessed GT as independent, competent and capable of performing a high-quality audit, citing its governance, ethical compliance, listed-company experience and proposed audit plan. The change was proposed after the board compared audit proposals from BDO and other firms, while BDO had not commenced FY2026 fieldwork.

data.title: Bonjour Holdings Reports Passage of All AGM Resolutions
data.description:

data.title: King Fook Reports Higher Interim Revenue and Profit
data.description:

data.title: ICBC Releases Board Director and Committee Role List
data.description:

data.title: Modern Dental Group Revenue Rises 9.3% in Nine Months
data.description:
An announcement from Modern Dental Group Limited ( (HK:3600) ) is now available.

Modern Dental Group operates in the dental industry and dental prosthetics sector, with international production facilities in Thailand, Vietnam and Mainland China. Its customer markets include Europe, North America, Greater China, Australia and other regions, while the company said digitalization is driving consolidation in dental prosthetics and its transformation initiatives are enhancing customer and patient experiences and operational efficiency.

For the nine months ended 30 September 2026, the Group reported approximately HK$3,009.0 million in revenue, up 9.3% from approximately HK$2,752.4 million a year earlier. The increase came amid softer demand for dental procedures and trade and geopolitical uncertainties; Europe and Australia grew in original currency, while North America declined.

data.title: ICBC Completes Redemption of 2021 Undated Additional Tier 1 Capital Bonds
data.description:
Industrial and Commercial Bank of China ( (HK:1398) ) has issued an update.

Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited is a bank incorporated in the People’s Republic of China. The bank issued RMB30 billion of undated additional Tier 1 capital bonds in the National Interbank Bond Market from 24 to 26 November 2021.

Under the issuance terms, the bank had the right to redeem the bonds in full at face value on the dividend payment date of the fifth interest accrual year, 26 November 2026. The bank exercised that right and completed the full redemption as at the announcement date, 27 November 2026.

data.title: Taung Gold Reports Six-Month 2026 Interim Results
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Taung Gold International Limited ( (HK:0621) ).

Taung Gold International Limited is incorporated in Bermuda and has stock code 621; the release provides no description of the company’s industry, products or market focus. Its board announced unaudited consolidated interim results for the six months ended 30 September 2026, alongside comparative figures for 2025.

data.title: Agricultural Bank of China Announces Director Departure
data.description:
Agricultural Bank of China ( (HK:1288) ) has issued an update.

Agricultural Bank of China Limited is a bank and a joint stock company incorporated in the People’s Republic of China.

Non-executive director Zhou Ji tendered her resignation from the board and three board committees, with her departure effective 27 November 2026 due to work adjustments. She confirmed there was no disagreement with the board, no outstanding public commitments, and no continuing role at the Bank or its controlled subsidiaries; the handover was completed and her departure will not reduce the board below the legal minimum. The board thanked her for her contributions.

data.title: Kantone Disposes of 1.75 Million China Star Shares
data.description:
The latest update is out from Kantone Holdings ( (HK:1059) ).

Kantone Holdings principally sells systems products, licenses and customises software, leases systems products and trades cultural products. China Star Entertainment, whose shares were sold, is engaged in investment, production, distribution and licensing of films and television drama series, artist management, and property development and investment.

On November 26, 2026, Kantone sold 1.75 million China Star shares on the market at an average HK$7.43 each for approximately HK$13.01 million, excluding transaction costs. The disposal is a discloseable transaction under Hong Kong listing rules because applicable percentage ratios exceed 5% but remain below 25%; after completion, the Group held no China Star shares.

data.title: China Water Affairs Reports Interim Results for Six Months Ended 30 September 2026
data.description:
China Water Affairs Group ( (HK:0855) ) has shared an announcement.

China Water Affairs Group Limited operates in water supply and environmental protection. Its reported activities include pipeline direct drinking water supply, city water supply, sewage treatment and drainage, and related installation, maintenance and construction services.
